## Excel Analysis Agent — service health

Every panel below is driven by the custom events emitted from `backend/app/telemetry.py`. Use the time-range control to change the window.

| Event | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `WorkbookUploaded` | A spreadsheet was accepted and stored as version 1 |
| `AnalysisRequested` | Deterministic column profiling ran |
| `ChartGenerated` | A chart was written into a new workbook version |
| `ChatTurn` | One agent turn (may contain several tool calls) |
| `AgentToolCall` | A single tool invocation by the model |
| `VersionDownloaded` | A user downloaded a workbook version |
| `OperationFailed` | Any operation that raised |

content.query:
customEvents
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| extend outcome = tostring(customDimensions.outcome)
| where isnotempty(outcome)
| summarize Succeeded = countif(outcome == 'success'), Failed = countif(outcome == 'failure') by bin(timestamp, 15m)
| order by timestamp asc
content.title: Operations over time

content.query:
customEvents
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| extend user = tostring(customDimensions.user_id)
| where isnotempty(user)
| summarize ActiveUsers = dcount(user) by bin(timestamp, 1h)
| order by timestamp asc
content.title: Active users per hour

content.query:
customEvents
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| extend outcome = tostring(customDimensions.outcome)
| where isnotempty(outcome)
| extend duration_ms = todouble(customMeasurements.duration_ms)
| summarize Calls = count(), ['Success %'] = round(100.0 * countif(outcome == 'success') / count(), 2), ['p50 ms'] = round(percentile(duration_ms, 50), 1), ['p95 ms'] = round(percentile(duration_ms, 95), 1) by Operation = name
| order by Calls desc
content.title: Per-operation success rate and latency

content.query:
customEvents
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where name == 'AgentToolCall'
| extend Tool = tostring(customDimensions.tool), outcome = tostring(customDimensions.outcome)
| summarize Calls = count(), Failures = countif(outcome == 'failure') by Tool
| order by Calls desc
content.title: Agent tool usage

content.query:
customEvents
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where name == 'OperationFailed'
| extend Operation = tostring(customDimensions.operation), ErrorType = tostring(customDimensions.error_type), Detail = tostring(customDimensions.error)
| summarize Count = count(), ['Last seen'] = max(timestamp), Example = any(Detail) by Operation, ErrorType
| order by Count desc
content.title: Failures by operation and error type

content.query:
requests
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| summarize Requests = count(), Failed = countif(success == false), ['p95 ms'] = round(percentile(duration, 95), 1) by Endpoint = name
| order by Requests desc
| take 20
content.title: HTTP endpoints
